saw_lines: Replacement lens buyers keep frames they already love, so they check fit and prescription before they read any brand story.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides their own frames are worth a new lens.
Your 28 copy ads carry no proof number, so collect one real figure, like orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

points: 0 of 28 copy ads carry a proof number, so a buyer has nothing firm to trust before paying. Take one real figure you can verify, like orders shipped, and lead your three best ads with it.
16 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the lens in the creative. Point each one to the product its creative shows, so the click lands on the lens the buyer just saw.

12 different openings across 28 copy ads, and the top one leads 5 of them. Repeated openers stop a scrolling buyer only once. Pick your two best stories and build the next batch from them, two new openings per story.

18 ads have run 60 days or more, so you already have proven winners to build from. Make three more variations of the oldest one, the Brittany H review, changing only its first line. Run each against your current batch.
